status: Practice brief for the Developer Dojo BIM pathway (BIM-007, BIM-008, BIM-R02). Written for the exercise; not a design, a services route or a programme.

duct.name: D-01 Supply duct (practice)
duct.description: Practice duct routed through the wall on purpose, so the coordination kata has a clash to find. Not sized or routed by a designer.

hardClash.meaning: Solids that overlap by more than this are a hard clash.
